notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: He has played 31 and 39 minutes in his last two games, with 29 points, 14 rebounds and 11 assists Monday and 24 points and 18 rebounds Wednesday. Miami has no other high-usage scorer beside him, and Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton and Ivica Zubac in the slate's highest-total game.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He scored 40 points with eight assists in 42 minutes Tuesday in an overtime win over Brooklyn. Chicago is without Nic Claxton, but the 15.5-point spread means Boston could rest its starters late if this gets away.
notes.Cade Cunningham: He has played 33, 36 and 39 minutes in his last three games, with 30 points and four threes Wednesday, and he has been shooting more threes with Jalen Duren out. Duren is out again tonight, and Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin.
notes.Alperen Sengun: He is questionable tonight with low back soreness after sitting Wednesday. Before that he had 29 points, nine rebounds and nine assists in 37 minutes Monday; if he sits, Fred VanVleet gets the biggest usage bump.
notes.Fred VanVleet: He scored 24 points with five assists in 29 minutes Wednesday with Alperen Sengun out. He is off the injury report for tonight, the first night of a back-to-back, so Saturday is the more likely rest day.
notes.Pascal Siakam: He had 26 points and 11 rebounds in 34 minutes Wednesday and has played 34 and 37 minutes in two of his last three games. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton, Ivica Zubac and T.J. McConnell, so the offense runs through him and Andrew Nembhard.
notes.Andrew Nembhard: He returned Wednesday with 18 points and 14 assists in 35 minutes and runs the offense with Tyrese Haliburton out week-to-week. He is listed probable tonight.
notes.Pelle Larsson: He has played more than 30 minutes off the bench in three straight games, with 17 points, six rebounds and eight assists in 31 minutes Wednesday. Miami has been riding him over its other wings.
notes.Bobby Portis: He has played 23 to 27 minutes off the bench in his last three games, with 11 points, nine rebounds and four assists Wednesday. He is a steady bench big in the slate's highest-total game.
notes.Jarace Walker: He played 29 minutes Monday and 22 Wednesday off the bench, with eight rebounds in both games. Indiana's frontcourt is thin with Ivica Zubac out, so he and Obi Toppin soak up big-man minutes behind Jay Huff.
notes.Klay Thompson: He is starting for Miami but playing only about two shifts a night, with 15 and 17 minutes in his last two games. His minutes are the risk at this price.
His minutes have gone up every game, reaching 27 Wednesday, when he scored 19 points on a team-high usage rate. Anthony Edwards had knee surgery Thursday and could miss up to two months, so Minnesota is filling his scoring by committee.
notes.LaMelo Ball: He becomes Minnesota's main creator with Anthony Edwards out, but foul trouble and turnovers have hurt him, including eight points and six turnovers in 28 minutes Wednesday.
notes.Trey Lyles: He played 22 minutes Wednesday, his most this season, as Minnesota adjusted to losing Anthony Edwards. He had been in the 13 to 14 minute range before that.
notes.Jakob Poeltl: He starts at center for Toronto but played only 10 minutes Wednesday after picking up five fouls in a blowout, and 19 the game before. He has taken very few shots, so his value rests on rebounds and minutes.
notes.Scottie Barnes: He scored 28 points with three steals and two blocks in 31 minutes Wednesday, and his role grows while Kawhi Leonard is out week-to-week with knee swelling.
notes.Jay Huff: He has started at center with Ivica Zubac out, but Indiana has kept him short of big minutes: 23 Monday and 16 Wednesday, with no blocks in either game. Larry Nance Jr. and Obi Toppin share the frontcourt.
notes.Mitchell Robinson: He has started at center for Boston, playing 16 to 25 minutes in his last three games. A lopsided spread could keep his minutes in that range.
notes.Jalen Smith: He is questionable tonight with a sprained left finger. He has started all season with Nic Claxton out and had 17 points, 11 rebounds and five assists in 30 minutes Wednesday; Claxton is out again tonight but close to a return.
notes.Luka Doncic: He sat Wednesday with back tightness but is not on the injury report and is available tonight at Golden State. He scored 52 points Sunday and 41 Tuesday in 37 to 38 minutes.
notes.Ziaire Williams: He is questionable tonight with no reason listed after sitting Wednesday. He had played 29 to 31 minutes as a starter in his three games before that.
notes.Stephen Curry: He scored 44 points with six threes in 32 minutes Wednesday. Golden State is again without Jimmy Butler, Moses Moody and Kristaps Porzingis, and Gui Santos is doubtful, so the shots run through him and Yaxel Lendeborg.
notes.Yaxel Lendeborg: He has played 31 to 36 minutes in his last three games and scored 26 to 31 points in each. He is off the injury report after a foot scare, and the Warriors' frontcourt is thin.
notes.Nikola Jokic: He had 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists Wednesday, in 34 minutes. Denver is without Julian Strawther, and Cameron Johnson is questionable with an ankle sprain.
notes.Jaylen Brown: He is questionable tonight with left knee soreness but has played in all five games, with 20 points and 10 rebounds in 34 minutes Wednesday. Joel Embiid and LeBron James are not on the report for the first night of a back-to-back.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: He has 13 to 20 rebounds in each of his last three games, including 27 points and 20 rebounds Tuesday. Philadelphia is thin up front with Tacko Fall, Dominick Barlow and Jabari Walker all out.
notes.Brandon Miller: He has played 36 or more minutes in each of his last four games and taken a huge share of the shots, with 31 points and 12 rebounds Wednesday. Charlotte is still without Coby White (calf) and Grant Williams (hamstring).
notes.Cooper Flagg: He has played 33 and 40 minutes since returning from his shoulder injury, with 26 points and eight assists Wednesday. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, and Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic are doubtful.
notes.Devin Booker: He scored only three points in 34 minutes Monday after a 43-point game. Phoenix is without Mark Williams, and Oso Ighodaro is questionable.
notes.Julius Randle: He played 44 minutes in Tuesday's overtime loss to Boston and gets a bigger load with Egor Demin out at least a week.
He had 27 points and 12 rebounds in 40 minutes Tuesday. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin, which leaves more shots for him and Julius Randle against Detroit.
